title: A Bar Song Line Dance Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions while facing away from the camera to mirror the students. She breaks down the dance into manageable 8-count segments, consistently adding counts and then music to reinforce learning.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance.
The teacher breaks down the first 8 counts.
The teacher adds counts to the first 8-count segment.
The teacher breaks down the second 8 counts.
The teacher adds counts to the second 8-count segment.
The teacher reviews the first 16 counts.
The teacher breaks down the third 8 counts.
The teacher adds counts to the third 8-count segment.
The teacher reviews the first 24 counts.
The teacher breaks down the fourth 8 counts.
The teacher adds counts to the fourth 8-count segment.
The teacher breaks down the tag.

cues: hop out with our right heel
metaphors: grapevine with a scuff at the end
safety: keeping our weight on that right foot

steps_taught.name: rumba box
steps_taught.description: A series of steps creating a box pattern.

steps_taught.name: step touches
steps_taught.description: Stepping to the side and touching the opposite foot.

steps_taught.name: grapevine
steps_taught.description: A side-to-side step pattern with a scuff.

steps_taught.name: hop and switch
steps_taught.description: Hopping and switching weight between feet.

what_works: The teacher's use of back-facing demonstrations makes it easy to follow along.
The incremental approach of adding counts and then reviewing segments helps build muscle memory.
what_hinders: The lack of music during the breakdown segments might make it harder to visualize the final performance.

quotes.text: we're going to step with our right foot to the side creating a rumba box
we're going to step to the side with our right foot
what we do to the right side we now got to do to the left
we're going to hop out with our right heel for one hold two
this song has a four count tag towards the end

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher demonstrates the rumba box step by stepping to the side and bringing the other foot in.
The teacher demonstrates step touches by stepping to the right and touching the left foot, then vice versa.
The teacher demonstrates the grapevine by stepping to the side, crossing behind, and stepping out.
The teacher demonstrates the hop and switch by hopping on the right heel and then switching to the left.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher consistently uses a 'back-facing' perspective for all demonstrations, which simplifies the learning process for students by mirroring their movements.
